title: Fade Passport
subtitle: Your grooming profile — yours, wherever you get cut.
emptyDescription: Save how you like your cut so any barber can get it right the first time.
preferencesNotes: Anything else your barber should know
shareDescription: Create a temporary, read-only link a barber can open. You can revoke it anytime.
shareOnce: Copy this now — for your security, the link is only shown once.
sharedExpiredDescription: Ask for a fresh link — share links are always time-limited.
sharedRevokedDescription: The customer turned this link off. Ask them for a new one.
sharedNotFoundDescription: Double-check the link, or ask for a new one.
